about: Synthetic English and Chinese evidence passages, queries, and tokenizer probes for the HW-008 bilingual search spike. Written for Hyper-Wiki; every result and number is invented. Each topic has one English and one Chinese passage reporting the same finding in independent wording, plus hard negatives on the same topic and lexical distractors.

passages.text: We distil a 12-layer teacher into a 6-layer student network. The student is 40% smaller and keeps 97% of the teacher's accuracy on the sentiment benchmark, while running 1.8 times faster.
本文将十二层教师模型的知识蒸馏到六层学生模型中。学生模型参数量减少约四成，在情感分类基准上仍保留教师模型97%的准确率，推理速度提升至1.8倍。
Structured channel pruning removed half of the convolutional filters in ResNet-50, and top-1 accuracy on ImageNet fell by only 1.2 points.
对ResNet-50进行结构化通道剪枝，删去一半卷积滤波器后，ImageNet上的top-1准确率只下降了1.2个百分点。
Quantizing the weights to 4 bits cut GPU memory use by a factor of 3.5, with perplexity rising by less than one point.
采用4比特权重量化后，模型的GPU显存占用减少约七成，困惑度上升不到1。
A message-passing graph neural network predicts molecular solubility with a mean absolute error of 0.58 log units, outperforming random forests on molecular fingerprints.
基于消息传递的图神经网络可预测分子溶解度，平均绝对误差为0.58个对数单位，优于基于分子指纹的随机森林。
By encoding multi-hop relation paths, our knowledge graph completion model reaches a Hits@10 of 0.62 on FB15k-237.
我们的知识图谱补全模型对多跳关系路径进行编码，在FB15k-237数据集上的Hits@10达到0.62。
Retrieval-augmented generation lowered the share of unsupported statements in long-form answers from 21% to 9%.
检索增强生成把长篇回答中缺乏依据的陈述比例从21%降到9%，明显缓解了大模型的幻觉问题。
Compared with experimentally determined structures, the predicted protein structures reached a median TM-score of 0.88.
与实验测定的结构相比，模型预测的蛋白质结构TM-score中位数为0.88。
Satellite land surface temperatures show that urban heat island intensity peaks on summer afternoons, at 4.3 °C above the surrounding farmland.
卫星地表温度数据表明，城市热岛强度在夏季午后达到峰值，比周边农田高4.3摄氏度。
Contrastive learning with in-batch negatives improves sentence embeddings, raising the average semantic textual similarity score by 4.1 points.
使用批内负样本的对比学习改善了句向量表示，语义文本相似度平均得分提高4.1分。
Back-translating monolingual text improved low-resource machine translation from Nepali to English by 5.6 BLEU.
利用单语语料进行回译，尼泊尔语到英语的低资源机器翻译提高了5.6个BLEU值。
Federated learning with differential privacy kept client data on the device and limited the accuracy loss to 2.4 points at epsilon 8.
结合差分隐私的联邦学习让客户端数据留在本地设备，在隐私预算ε为8时准确率仅损失2.4个百分点。
Fine-tuning BERT with a lexicon adapter improved Chinese named entity recognition, reaching an F1 score of 95.1 on the MSRA dataset.
在BERT模型中加入词典适配器进行微调，提升了中文命名实体识别效果，在MSRA数据集上的F1值达到95.1。
Sparse attention patterns let the Transformer process sequences of 32,000 tokens while memory grows only linearly with sequence length.
稀疏注意力机制使Transformer能处理长度为32000个词元的序列，而内存开销只随序列长度线性增长。
Across 48 field plots, soil microbial diversity was positively correlated with maize yield (r = 0.57).
在48个田间小区中，土壤微生物多样性与玉米产量呈显著正相关（r = 0.57）。
This survey of graduate students finds that research stress is negatively correlated with sleep quality.
本研究调查了研究生的科研压力与睡眠质量，发现两者呈负相关。
Deep reinforcement learning reached a 92% success rate on robotic grasping tasks.
深度強化學習在機器人抓取任務中的成功率達到92%。
Dataset distillation compresses CIFAR-10 into 50 synthetic images per class, but models trained on them lose 18 points of accuracy.
非结构化剪枝能够移除九成权重，但在通用GPU上几乎无法带来实际加速。
Quantizing activations to 8 bits during training slowed convergence by roughly 30 percent.
图神经网络被用于城市交通流量预测，高峰时段的预测误差比循环神经网络低12%。
Entity alignment across multilingual knowledge graphs remains difficult when their relation schemas differ.
检索模块的延迟占问答系统总响应时间的六成，是部署时的主要瓶颈。
Protein-ligand docking scores correlated only weakly with measured binding affinity (Spearman 0.31).
城市绿地面积每增加10%，夜间地表温度平均下降0.6摄氏度。
Supervised contrastive learning for image classification is sensitive to the temperature hyperparameter.
多语言预训练模型在零样本跨语言迁移中表现良好，但在低资源语言上仍明显落后。
Secure aggregation adds communication overhead that grows with the number of federated clients.
中文分词错误会沿流水线传播，使下游命名实体识别的F1值下降约3分。
Rotary position embeddings extrapolate poorly beyond the training context length unless positions are interpolated.
长期施用化肥使土壤酸化，土壤pH值在十年内下降了0.8。
原油常压蒸馏装置的分馏效率受进料温度影响显著，实验测得最佳进料温度为360摄氏度。
冬季剪枝使苹果树单株产量提高了15%，但对果实糖度没有显著影响。
我们研究生命起源早期的化学反应路径，发现矿物表面能够催化核苷酸聚合。
Fractional distillation of crude oil depends strongly on feed temperature; separation peaked at 360 °C.
